in_sanskrit.name: धर्मदास
in_sanskrit.meaning: धर्म (righteousness, law, duty, virtue, morality, virtue, justice, religion, path, rule, truth) + दास (servant, slave, devotee, disciple, bondman)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who serves (or follows) righteousness, law, duty, virtue, morality, virtue, justice, religion, path, rule, truth

in_hindi.name: धर्मदास
in_hindi.long_meaning: धर्मवान दास (One who possesses righteousness and is a servant)

in_tamil.name: தர்மதாச
in_tamil.long_meaning: தர்மப்படுத்துவான தாச் (One who establishes righteousness and is a servant)

in_telugu.name: ధర్మదాశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: ధర్మపోయే దాశ్ (One who follows righteousness and is a servant)

in_marathi.name: Dharmdas
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Dharma (duty, righteousness) + Das (servant)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharmdas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who serves the righteous path and dharma. This name is inspired by ancient Hindu texts, emphasizing the importance of living a virtuous and dutiful life.
